explain: Actions this machine does by itself at set times. A task acts with the rights of the person who created it, checked again at every run. If it cannot run, you are told.
name: Name
warn: The task will run on its own. Restarting or pruning cannot be undone. Cleaning up stopped containers also removes those of projects you stopped on purpose. Unused networks: only networks that no container, running or stopped, is attached to are removed, so a stopped proxy keeps its network; add the armadok.protect=true label to a network to keep it for sure.
actions.project.redeploy: Update a project (pull images, then start)
presets.daily: Every day at a time I choose
cron.label: Cron expression ({{zone}})
cron.help: Five fields: minute, hour, day of the month, month, day of the week. Never more often than every 15 minutes. Pick an example to start from it.
missed: This task was due at {{at}} but Armadok was stopped, so it did not run.
